description: Use this when the user wants the FlareWarden account's own name changed: the name its members see in the sidebar and account switcher, and invitations carry. Renames it as the Account page does and returns the old and new name. Owners and admins only. Not for a site's name (use update_monitor) or a status page's (use update_status_page).
name: rename_account
title: Rename the account
